title: Lighthouse engagement & beta-readiness signal framework
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Create a repeatable framework to determine when a candidate account or cohort is ready to be treated as a Lighthouse (high-touch beta) and to coordinate cross-functional go-to-market activities and release-notes sync for that cohort. This ticket scopes the signals we use, the operational playbook for engagement, and the artifacts required before a Lighthouse is announced to sales/marketing and scheduled for post-beta rollout.

Context: multiple PMs requested clearer pass/fail signals for early customers. We aim to standardize the decision process so that engineering and support know when to prioritize fixes and when to proceed with broader activation and co-marketing.
success_criteria: A defined checklist of objective readiness signals (telemetry + manual) used to grade Lighthouse candidates
A one-page engagement playbook template that PMs can copy per-customer
Documented release-notes coordination steps and single source of truth for public messaging
Operational runbook for handoff from beta to GA including ownership, timelines, and rollback triggers
milestones: Mar 03: Draft readiness signals and share with ENG/CS/Design for feedback
Mar 10: Iterate checklist based on feedback; add telemetry thresholds (latency, error-rate, cost per 1k tokens)
Mar 17: Pilot checklist with two lighthouse candidates and capture lessons
Apr 01: Finalize playbook and release-notes template; align with marketing launch calendar
Apr 15: Complete handoff for cohort A and prepare post-beta report
tasks: Define quantitative signals: baseline latency p95 < 350ms, error-rate < 0.5%, memory OOM events = 0, KV cache hit ratio > 60%
Define qualitative signals: positive CSAT from pilot contacts, feature acceptance criteria met in demo checklist
Create Lighthouse Engagement Playbook template (objectives, success metrics, meeting cadence, escalation path)
Create Release Notes Coordination checklist (stake owners, embargo windows, example language, approval flow)
Instrument telemetry dashboards and set alert thresholds for beta cohort (Grafana/Datadog links)
Run two-week pilot with backend autoscaling tweaks and capture regression metrics
Prepare post-pilot decision memo (GO/NO-GO) with recommended mitigations and timeline
Schedule cross-functional readiness review (PM/Eng/SRE/CS/Marketing) one week before public announcement
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use a conservative p95 latency threshold (350ms) for lighthouse eligibility to avoid false negatives; tradeoff is fewer candidates qualify initially.
Decision: Require KV cache hit ratio signal only for workloads using cache; tradeoff is added instrumentation effort for partial workloads.
Tradeoff: Offer limited co-marketing to Lighthouse accounts during beta to reduce PR risk; will revisit for GA depending on post-beta stability.

open_questions: What is the minimum duration for a lighthouse pilot to gather statistically meaningful telemetry? (SRE recommends 7-14 days depending on traffic)
Who formally signs off on the GO/NO-GO? (Proposed: PM + Eng lead + CS lead + SRE lead)
Do we allow feature-flagged beta-only config that is not present in GA? (Legal/Compliance wants a review if data residency differs)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Premature public announcement leading to escalations. Mitigation: require explicit signoff checklist and embargoed messaging held by Marketing until GA readiness confirmed.
Risk: Telemetry blindspots for low-traffic customers. Mitigation: supplement with synthetic load tests and manual acceptance criteria.
Risk: Support overhead spikes. Mitigation: allocate a dedicated CS contact and on-call rotation for the first 30 days of pilot.
post_pilot_outputs: Decision memo with GO/NO-GO and recommended mitigations
Updated runbook and alert suppression config for GA handoff

Post-beta telemetry baseline and lessons-learned doc (to be stored in Drive)
